name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'chapter_event_handler' is the domain; '1c' is the per-event dispatch-table index 0x1C (DATA xref at 0x51c01 = table_base 0x51b91 + 0x1C*4 holds LE 0x00034a0e), a meaningful domain ID, NOT a Ghidra address residue; '__ch8_ai_ctrl' accurately describes the chapter-8 turn-15 AI-control beat. No address residue.
purpose: Chapter 8 turn-15 AI-control beat: clear the low 7 bits of combat_aux_block[0xD] (the ai_class / sub-state byte) for the 18 runtime-char slots 0x0A..0x1B, preserving only bit 7.
logic_summary: for (i = 0; i < 0x12; i++) runtime_char[i + 10].combat_aux_block[0xD] &= 0x80;  -- 18 iterations over runtime-char slots 0x0A..0x1B; AND-mask keeps bit 7 (high 'locked' bit) and clears bits 0-6. No dialog, no RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value used. Disasm confirms: __CHK(8) probe; per-slot address = runtime_char_array_base[0x53a45] + (i+10)*0x50, field +0x34 (= combat_aux_block base +0x27, index 0xD); AND byte ptr,0x80; loop bound CMP EDX,0x12. EBX is callee-saved (PUSH/POP EBX).
